econ-crypto-01-c1.text: Leslie Lamport, Robert Shostak, Marshall Pease (1982). The Byzantine Generals Problem. ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems (Microsoft Research publication page, with Lamport's note).
econ-crypto-01-c1.quote: The main reason for writing this paper was to assign the new name to the problem.
econ-crypto-01-c1.claim: Computer scientists call this the Byzantine Generals Problem.

econ-crypto-01-c3.quote: The Merge reduced Ethereum's energy consumption by ~99.95%.
econ-crypto-01-c3.claim: Ethereum made the switch from PoW in 2022 (the 'Merge'), and its energy consumption fell ~99.95%.
